scope: Cosmetic road weather only; game events, RNG, resources and world clock unchanged.
particles: Screen-space layers with wind, tumbling leaves/petals, depth-scaled snow, rain and ground splashes; terrain profiles blend with the scenery.

lightning.trigger: road_100 storm; ramps in during approach
lightning.geometry: Random sky start, segmented main bolt and three branches; independent visual hash
lightning.cadence: one bolt in each 8-second block with 0.35 to 3.35 second randomized onset
lightning.soft: Fewer slower particles and no sky flash; lightning remains visible.
lightning.camera: Drawn once in sky screen space, never in the scaled encounter object.

performance: Existing 30fps canvas loop; cached 72-particle pool and eight bolt shapes; no new DOM particles, image downloads or AI runtime.
interiors: No outdoor weather inside buildings or character battles.
